snippet.title: Night Shift: Security - Official Horror Indie Game Trailer (Indonesia)
snippet.description:
Step into the forgotten dark with Night Shift: Security, a chilling psychological horror experience from Bite X Studios.

What begins as a simple night guard assignment inside a long-abandoned office tower slowly descends into a surreal nightmare. Unexplainable malfunctions plague the building. Shadows shift when no one is there. And... something deep inside the structure has been waiting.

Release Date: June 21, 2025
at https://bitexstudios.itch.io

Are you ready to uncover the secrets buried within Sinar Media Harindo?  Watch the official trailer and prepare for a shift you’ll never forget.

The night won’t be silent… Will you survive it?
#NightShiftSecurity #PsychologicalHorror #IndieGame #GameDevIndonesia
